title: Pathogenic atypical Treg in ICI‑induced inflammatory arthritis and abrogation by IL‑6R blockadeblockade
projectDescription: OLINK proteomics of human synovial lines (MH7A) co-cultured with blood-derived Treg cells ofICI-IA patients, as compared to human synovial lines (MH7A) without co-culture system
sampleProcessingProtocol: Peripheral blood were collected from ICI‑IA patients and controls. Mononuclear cells were isolated by density gradient centrifugation. Tregs were enriched using CD4⁺CD25⁺CD127ᵈⁱᵐ magnetic beads (Miltenyi). CD137⁺ AtpTregs were further isolated for functional assays. OLINK proteomics was performed on MH7A synoviocytes co‑cultured with ICI‑IA patient‑derived Tregs versus control MH7A. All samples were processed fresh or cryopreserved for batch analysis.
dataProcessingProtocol: OLINK NPX values were analyzed using paired Wilcoxon tests. Statistics were performed in R and GraphPad Prism (v9.5) with Benjamini‑Hochberg correction.
